correctness.rationale: The mathematical order-game lifting argument is quantifier-free in the selected vertices and proves the infinite H_n tail from n>=15. Exhaustive exact tuple-type recursion over all ordered four-tuples (including repetitions) correctly recognizes all rank-four formulas, and computes type IDs 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,6,...,6 across n=1..15. Independent direct four-move adversarial EF minimax checks n=4 vs5, 5 vs6, 6 vs7 inequivalent and 7 vs8 equivalent. The recurrence and all necessary computations were run from bundled standalone paths; code/output checks are separate from the infinite mathematical argument.

value.rationale: Half-graphs are canonical witnesses of the order property, so the exact uncoloured four-round length visibility boundary is a motivated finite-model-theoretic invariant. The classification sharpens the generic order-transfer bound of fifteen to seven, fully resolves all seven rank-four theories, and gives a sharp fourteen-vertex minimal representative within the half-graph family. In addition, all four-vertex atomic patterns stabilize at n=4 by index compression, so the further n=4,5,6 distinctions demonstrate the actual expressive gain from quantifier alternation rather than merely larger induced subgraphs.
